ai.title: Manual compact rethrows API refusals and adds session-ended message
ai.summary: The agent runtime now distinguishes provider refusals from transient errors during conversation summarization. A new `rethrowRefusals` flag in `packages/agent-runtime/src/conversation-summary.ts` causes `summarizeAndLog` to rethrow errors that are not `SummaryError` or aborts, effectively propagating API or provider rejections to the caller. This flag is enabled only for manual compactions in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` via `rethrowRefusals: options.trigger === 'manual'`, ensuring that if a /compact request is refused because a session ended or by policy, the run ends on that refusal rather than failing silently. ai.title: Add silent timeout retry to SDK stream
ai.summary: The SDK now retries a single model stream request when it hits a 5-minute inactivity timeout before receiving any output. This mechanism checks for `isFetchIdleTimeoutError` and ensures no model output parts, such as text or tool calls, have been received yet, preventing duplicate content. If the timeout occurs under these conditions, the function yields a warning and recursively calls `promptAiSdkStream` with a flag to prevent an infinite loop. The retry is skipped for BYOK requests, as their timeouts are handled by existing stream interruption recovery, and it also respects user-initiated cancellations.
ai.evidence: The diff in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` adds an `idleTimeoutRetried` parameter to `promptAiSdkStream` and implements `silentTimeoutRetry`, which triggers a recursive `yield*` call when `isFetchIdleTimeoutError` returns true and `receivedModelOutput` is false; the test file `silent-timeout-retry.test.ts` verifies this behavior with titles like 'sends a request that timed out before any output once more'.

eli5.text: The software library now automatically resends a request to the AI model if the connection becomes silent for five minutes before any answer begins. This applies to anyone using the free tier of the coding assistant through the standard service, not those connecting their own private AI keys. You will notice that occasional unresponsive delays resolve themselves into a working answer instead of ending in an error, with no extra steps required.
